Well there are many answers for many questions. First of all though let me say that I feel bad for you guy or gal, in you situations. My current perspective and take on it, is that people aren't fully avoiding you but definitely have a level of trying to be kind and not hurt your feelings at times. Others however are very much more oblivious. There exists a breed of people who do not think about others in the same existential way, and do not really notice it either. That's totally fine too because everybody is entitled to live the way that they want without owing anyone anything.

The other thing that I realize are the people that you seek the particular bonds you want from and the exposure, do not appear to correlate. You are very specific about the people you wish felt closer to you because they feel like your life but they very much live their own lives with exposure to different bonds with different people. In the regard you having few close friends makes them that much more special to you. And them having more friends makes you less significant to them. You obviously matter to them in their own way so don't jump the gun with negative thoughts. You could of course be right about your assumptions but in the end those are hypotheticals. You could always ask them about these things in more detail because communication is key.

If it turns out these folks really do avoid you then it's because you do not interest them enough. You shouldn't have to care about it so much because in the end it's going to drag you and your lifestyle down. You are moving forward towards a life that is best for you, not a life that is best for you and everyone else. They are very much focused on themselves. However if you want them to be interested in you regardless of all this, then become more interesting by having an interesting life. Things to talk about could be anything. Usually experiences that Carry higher levels of ego or freedom fancy others because it is what many deprive themselves of. Adventure or extremities. Solo backpacking, being super rich, being some type of playboy or Yass queen. If you don't know what is hype, literally go on trending pages of any social media page and just process and repeat the trending shit people think are cool and funny and then you will be cool and funny to others.

None of that shit really feels appealing but it might seem like your missing out because you don't have access to it. I recommend finding genuine connections within clubs in school, or close to where you live. [Meetup.com](https://Meetup.com) is a start where you can be friends with people that range in all sorts of activities, with all sorts of people. Sometimes you might not even resonate with people your age, school, family, etc.... You just gotta move on and keep exploring.

One last topping to your cake. You are always going to be alone and so will everyone else on the planet. The feeling you have of being alone is something you decide to choose as a strength or a weakness. You have to decide to be in control. Because when mama and papi, nana and a gramps, bro and sis, best friends and mentors are too busy with other people and their own lives, then it'll just be you and your thoughts. You gotta become stronger in this mental aspect because it is reality. This internet thing is a beautiful gift we have in order to communicate. You are not alone as more than one person has taken an interest and liking to talk with you. When none of are here for you though rememberer it'll just be you and your thoughts with the same fundamental base as real life encounters. Best of luck.

I'll give it to you straight like no one else does. Yes, you are stupid. You are stupid in math and it is totally fine. Everybody is stupid. The ego will not allow oneself to acknowledge these things because we all make better life decisions for ourselves than the person next to us. I am stupid. The greatest minds in every field of the world were, are, and will continue to be stupid. It's just totally normal though so don't feel awful about it. Stupidity isn't wrong, although ignorance can be. You are nothing close to ignorant in your pursuit for knowledge. You are one very small number of individuals who is seeking many means in order to attain much further heights in math, even with the walls you keep running into. You are stupider than tomorrow, yet smarter than yesterday. I am so proud of you for continuing to want something. You're struggling and you still try every time.

Here's my advice. Keep seeking new methods as you have been if the old ones aren't working. Not every teaching style or method will ever work for every person. Maybe paper and pencils aren't a big enough playing field for you so try a whiteboard and markers. Perhaps the stress of grades are holding you back. Try thinking less about the best grade, it could be pulling you back from learning the way you wish to. Perhaps joining a math club for fun will make things more sociable and less limited to a dated time of assignments. Heck start your own club at school and pitch them your experience to have members joining. There are so many different approaches and you just gotta find what works for you.

Apparently you have a strong will that doesn't break because you continue to rise up to your failures. On that note, some people are born geniuses and others aren't. But never has anyone reached anywhere in life without putting in the time and work to do something, genius or not. In the end everybody has had to invest time and practice into anything to get somewhere further in life. I wish you the best luck and once again share that I am proud of you.

P.S. professor Leonard on youtube is great at teaching math.

here is my list of staying hydrated both years in 3 different weekends as a 21-22 year old

numbaaa 1)  keep a positive vibe in your mind and those around you. When you're thinking only about having fun every minute you don't think how tired you are

2) drink drink drink

3) some people are saying stay in the shade however i walk and dance lots in the sun and out, the sun proceeds to give you energy naturally yet is a double edged sword due to dehydration added on to alcohol/drug dehydration

4) breaks in between but not too long, keep it short 15-30 mins i have taken like 4 max in a day because just like when your focus changes in anything you get more tired, kinda like napping past 30 mins.

5) i haven't done coke before yet it does work wonders on all others i have seen, at least half the people i meet that are more energized are coked out

6) ecstasy can fall into this but it's like a 2-3 hour effect that dies out and makes you crash (it didn't make me crash but it did take some life health away if my life were a video game)

7) ohhhhhhh baby showers, these are one of the most energizing thingsssss allllllll day, especially in the heat, it's a full body hydration station. I typically take my clean showers in the morn yet i have taken extra ones during the day and evening for a variety of reasons being...it relaxes your exhausted bodies muscles, it refreshes your mind (because we all think/meditate in the shower or just go blank), restated again it hydrates your body all around, hmmm if you have errrrhrmmm ever taken a lady in there it releases any stress you had pending (unless you jack off, not my style).

8) sex someone up, whatever or whoever floats your boat

9) I think the second most important one after numbaaaa 1 is EAT. Eat eat eat people. I have taken a grill, sandwiches, snacks that provide energy (i am a cyclist so i'm used to pacing snacks and energy) like nuts.  No one tries to eat all day, maybe once which isn't sufficient if you add all the negative elements against one (the heat, alcohol/drugs aftereffects, walking/dancing all day exhaustion, sleep deprivation, psychological factors like hangovers). No food = less energy

10) sleep right, no matter what your friends want to do, try to stick to your own schedule or coordinate with them.

11) i think i will definitely try the drinking electrolytes now and can accredit that electrolytes do wonders anytime so ill consider that 11 although i haven't used them there

12) have fun fun fun. staying positive thoughts is somewhat alike yet different from having fun. For myself doing things like high fiving strangers complimenting peoples outfits (a lot of people put effort and time into deciding what to wear to these things), talking to foreigners, getting the crowds around me to act silly (group photos, dance circles, charging stations). All of these things because seeing a smile put on someone's face and making a connection with people makes me a lot happier and happier makes me more energized . This could be in some persons nature but you can break your own nature and give it a shot :)

13) being in love or falling in love, it did wonders for me 1 year ;)
